name: Phil
description: I was driving Northeast on HWY 1 next to a pecan orchard going about 65 mph on my way to work just as the sun was coming up. I noticed a light out of the right side of my windshield above the trees maybe 100 feet off the ground. It was keeping pace with my truck and did so for about 10-15 second. Once I started to really get a look at it, it sped north east at an extreme speed and disappeared at the horizon. It was so fast it created a visual effect that looked like it stretched long ways the direction it headed. It was less than a second from the time it zipped away to the time it disappeared at the horizon. Looked faster than anything flying around the Augusta, GA area.
